# U5: Load your own data and switch between it and the example; the switcher says Switch, and landing as someone else says who you are there

- **Belongs to:** the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)); it runs with every module on, and the core journeys run again with each module left out
- **Requirements:** `WORKSPACES`, `ONBOARDING`, `CHANGE-LOG`, `ADMIN`
- **Budget:** at most 15 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** every point but `attention` ([the ease test](../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Grace, at `/` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U5

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Grace (`grace`).
- Go to `/` in the demo.
- _Note:_ Setting up your own is in the workspace switcher, at the top of the sidebar or the phone's top bar (backlog WS).
- **Step.** Open the workspace switcher (the sidebar’s header on a computer, the top bar’s line on a phone).
- **Check:** (`entry`) the “Set up a new workspace” button in the Workspaces dialog is in view without scrolling (above the phone’s tab bar).
- **Check:** Checkpoint “admin home”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the “Set up a new workspace” button in the Workspaces dialog.
- **Check:** The step counter shows.
- **Check:** (`progress`) a progress indicator (a ring, steps, dots, a checklist or a bar) is visible.
- **Step.** Type “Platform Engineering” into the “Workspace name” field.
- _Note:_ Set up from inside the app, it starts as the person you are (backlog WS): one line, with Change, not three fields (ST2).
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `/^Setting up as Grace Achterberg, grace/i.test(meLine) && !(await p.getByLabel('Your email').count())`, where `const meLine = await p.locator('.setup-me').innerText()`. Else it says: step 1 does not start as one line about you: “{meLine}”.
- **Step.** Press the “Change” button in the “Which one is you?” step of set-up.
- **Step.** Type “Grace Achterberg” into the “Your name” field.
- **Step.** Type “Leadership” into the “Your team” field.
- **Check:** “You’ll be this workspace’s admin” is shown.
- _Note:_ An email tells people apart, so a missing one is explained before going on.
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `/grace/i.test(await p.getByLabel('Your email').inputValue())`. Else it says: the opened fields do not start with your own email.
- Empty the “Your email” field.
- Press the “Continue to people” button.
- **Check:** (`errors`) an alert showing “Add your email” is visible (else: a missing email is not explained).
- **Step.** Type “grace.achterberg@example.com” into the “Your email” field.
- **Step.** Press the “Continue to people” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/workspace/new/people”.
- **Check:** “Who’s on it?” is shown.
- _Note:_ A second person with your name is allowed (the email is who someone is, backlog N), and said on their row; a row with no team takes yours.
- Type “Grace Achterberg” into the “Person 1: name” field.
- **Check:** (`errors`) a status line showing “is already here” is visible (else: a shared name is not noted on its row).
- _Note:_ Pasting rows from a spreadsheet fills the table.
- **Check:** It fails if pasted rows did not fill the table.
- **Check:** It fails if the pasted Admin column was not read.
- _Note:_ The Excel template downloads, and uploading it back reads both sheets.
- Choose a file to load; the file is `file`, where `` const file = path.join(OUT, `template-${device}.xlsx`) ``.
- **Check:** “added 2 people after the 2 you’d typed; 2 in the file were already there. It also has a goals sheet” is shown.
- **Step.** Press the “Continue to goals” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/workspace/new/goals”.
- **Step.** Press the “Import a spreadsheet” choice.
- **Check:** “Using the ” is shown (else: the goals step does not say it is using the goals sheet uploaded on People).
- **Check:** Checkpoint “starting point”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the “Continue to check” button.
- **Check:** “Deploy lead time” is shown (else: the check step shows the outcome from the file).
- **Check:** Checkpoint “check”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the “Create Platform Engineering” button.
- **Check:** “Platform Engineering is ready” is shown.
- **Check:** (`finish`) the main button in the celebrate (`.celebrate .btn.primary`) is visible (else: no way on after creating).
- Go to `/` in the demo.
- **Check:** “Grace” is shown (else: home now speaks to the new workspace’s admin).
- Set up in the page’s own script, not a step a person takes: it runs `() => localStorage.getItem('goals-app-workspace')`.
- **Check:** (`logged`) met when `!!s && s.changes.some((c) => c.action === 'imported' && /5 people/.test(c.summary))`, where `const wsId = await p.evaluate(() => localStorage.getItem('goals-app-workspace'))`; `const s = await h.snapshot(wsId)`. Else it says: creating the workspace is not logged.
- _Note:_ Switching workspace is the switcher at the top of the sidebar (backlog WS), as real navigation: Back returns. It reads as a control, not a title: on a computer it says Switch (outside review, 12 Nov).
- If on a computer:
  - **Check:** (`entry`) the ws switch word in the ws switch in the side (`.side .ws-switch .ws-switch-word`) is visible (else: the workspace switcher does not say Switch).
- _Note:_ Last time in the example this browser was Rhea, a member: landing there says so, once (outside review, 12 Nov).
- Look as Rhea (`rhea`) in the workspace `platform-org` from here on, as choosing them in the Demo panel does (the browser’s storage: `goals-app-viewer:platform-org` is `rhea`).
- Open the workspace switcher (the sidebar’s header on a computer, the top bar’s line on a phone).
- _Note:_ The example's row says what kind it is (WR2): its name is the same as the one just made.
- Press the “Example data” button in the Workspaces dialog.
- **Check:** “You’re Rhea Kapoor here, a member.” is shown (else: landing in another workspace as someone else does not say who you are there).
- **Check:** The ws name in the side, or the ws switch top (`.side .ws-name:visible, .ws-switch-top:visible`) showing “Platform Engineering / Example data” shows.
- Press the browser’s Back.
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `back`, where `const wsId = await p.evaluate(() => localStorage.getItem('goals-app-workspace'))`; `const back = await p.waitForFunction((id) => localStorage.getItem('goals-app-workspace') === id, wsId, { timeout: 5000 }).then(() => true, () => false)`. Else it says: Back after switching did not return to the workspace switched from.
- Close this browser.
